s: Dine nepilat appayim ubo v' seipim: leachar shessiyyem hashsheliach tzibbur chazarat hattepilla — nopelim al penehem umitchannenim kol maqom lepi minhago. Vegam iqqar nepilat appayim hu minhag shennahagu kol yisrael mimot olam. Veap al pi ken enah choba ella reshut, laken kol hilkoteha teluyot bamminhag kemo sheyyitbaer. Utechinna zo shemmitchannen binpilat appayim tzarik lomar miyyad achar hattepilla, abal im hipsiq veasaq bidbarim acherim achar hattepilla — shub en techinnato nishmaat kol kak. Laken en ledabber ben tepilla linpilat appayim (ap al pi shemmin haddin en issur baddabar, shehare iqqar nepilat appayim hi reshut). Umikkol maqom en tzarik lizzaher ella millehapsiq velaasoq bidbarim acherim legamre, abal sicha muetet en lachosh. Vekol sheen mapsiqin bidbarim acherim legamre — yakol lelek achar hattepilla lemaqom acher lippol sham al panayv. Veiqqar nepilat appayim shennahagu bah bayyamim harishonim hi lippol al panayv artza apillu shello bepishshut yadayim veraglayim (vaapillu yosheb al haaretz venopel al panayv artza). Veadam chashub eno rashshay lippol al panayv beinyan zeh bipne hatztzibbur keshemmitpallel al hatztzibbur im en hatztzibbur nopelim kak kamohu, ella im ken hu batuach bemaasayv sheyyeaneh kihoshua bin nun, (shehare) neemar bo "qum lak lamma zeh atta nopel al paneka" (mashma sheen lo lippol), lepi sheim lo yeaneh miyyad — yeharharu hatztzibbur acharayv lomar sheeno hagun veeno rauy leanot. Veken kol adam asur lippol al panayv artza al gabbe ritzpat abanim apillu shello bepishshut yadayim veraglayim, gezera mishshum hishtachavaa bepishshut yadayim veraglayim shehi asura min hattora veloqin alayv, shenneemar: "veeben maskit lo tittenu beartzekem lehishtachavot aleha", veeno muttar ella bammiqdash bilbad. Veim eno madbiq panayv baqqarqa ella matteh al tziddo — muttar apillu leadam chashub bipne hatztzibbur, vaapillu al gabbe ritzpat abanim shello bepishshut yadayim veraglayim kemo sheyyitbaer. Veakshav shello nahagu lippol al penehem mammash ella behattayat harosh vekissuy happanim bilbad — lo shayyak kol zeh. Vekevan sheen nopelin mammash ella shemmekasseh panayv — nahagu lippol apillu meummad. Ak al pi haqqabbala rauy lihyot nepilat appayim meyushshab. Veim i epshar lesheb bemaqom shekkalu hag' pesiot — yamtin kede hilluk d' ammot veyachazor limqomo veyippol meyushshab. Venohagim lekassot happanim bebeged, velo day bekissuy hayyad shennopel panayv aleha, lepi shehayyad vehappanim gup echad hen veen haggup yakol lekassot et atzmo kemo shennitbaer siman a"d vtz"a. Venahagu bimqomot harbeh lehattot al tzad semol, lepi shemmatzinu kesheadam mitpallel shekina mimino, shenneemar: "Hashem tzilleka al yad yemineka", ukemo shennitbaer besiman tz"z. Nimtza keshehu mutteh al semolo panayv kelappe shekina, veim haya mutteh al yemino haya lehepek, velo yittaken laebed lihyot achorayv kelappe adonayv. Veyesh omerim lehattot al yad yemino, shekkeshehu mutteh al yemino ushekina kenegdo — yekavven "semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbeqeni". Venahagu bimdinot ellu lehattot beshacharit al yemino velo al semolo mishshum kebod hattepillin shebbismolo, ubemincha o apillu beshacharit kesheen lo tepillin bismolo — matteh al semolo. Vehashsheliach tzibbur haomed mimin haaron — tob sheyyatteh rosho meat kelappe haaron ap keshennopel al yad yemino (vehu haddin hayyoshebim betzad hammenora lipne haaron venopelim al penehem lammizrach kemo hashsheliach tzibbur). Al pi haqqabbala yesh lomar mizmor "eleka Hashem napshi essa". Ak mippene shehaomero velibbo rachoq mimmennu gorem lo leheasep belo itto, lepikak nimneu leomro bimdinot ellu, ella omerim "rachum vechannun ku' Hashem al beappeka ku'":

Leachar shennapal al panayv — yagbiah rosho veyitchannen meat meyushshab, kol maqom umaqom lepi minhago. Uminhag pashut lomar "vaanachnu lo neda mah naaseh ku'", lepi shehitpallalnu bekol inyan sheyyukal adam sheyyitpallel, bishiba ubaamida ubinpilat appayim, kaasher asa mosheh rabbenu alayv hashshalom, shenneemar: "vaesheb bahar vego' vaetnappal lipne Hashem vego'", umeachar sheen banu koach lehitpallel beinyan acher — anu omerim "vaanachnu lo neda mah naaseh ku'". Veachar kak chatzi qaddish, "ashre", "lamnatztzeach":

Yesh nohagim sheen nopelim appayim ella bemaqom sheyyesh sham seper tora. Vesiman laddabar bemilchemet haay "vayyippol al panayv … lipne aron Hashem". Ubemaqom sheen seper tora — nohagin lomar techinna belo kissuy panim. Vachatzar bet hakkeneset happetucha lebet hakkeneset — hammitpalelim bah keshebbet hakkeneset patuach nohagim lomar techinna binpilat appayim kemo bebet hakkeneset atzmo, abal lo keshebbet hakkeneset naul. Ubet hakkeneset shel nashim hi kebayit echad leinyan zeh im bet hakkeneset shehasseper tora betokah apillu eno patuach lo, venohagim lomar bo binpilat appayim. Abal azara shellipne bet hakkeneset — dinah kachatzar bet hakkeneset. Apillu yachid hammitpallel bebeto keshemmitpallel beshaa shehatztzibbur mitpalelin bebet hakkeneset — yakol lippol immahem beshaa shehem nopelim, shehare hu keillu omed immahem, sheapillu mechitztza shel barzel enah mapseqet ben yisrael laabihem shebbashshamayim kol sheyyesh asara bemaqom echad, kemo shennitbaer besiman n"h:

En nepilat appayim ballayla, mittaam hayyadua layyodeim. Lepikak im nimsheka tepillat hammincha ad hallayla — en lippol al panayv. Veyesh ledalleg "abinu malkenu" kede lippol mibbeod yom. Umikkol maqom en lachosh lezeh ella bevadday layla, abal lo beben hashshemashot. Venohagim lippol al penehem belel ashmurot, hoil vehu qarob layyom. Veyesh nohagim lehaarik basselichot ad nekon hayyom, veaz nopelim al penehem:

Nahagu shello lippol al penehem bebet hechatan beyom kenisato lachuppa, mippene sheyyom tob shello hu. Velo bebet hakkeneset beyom mila, mippene shemmitzvat mila besimcha qibbelu alehem. Velo kesheyyesh sham chatan bebet hakkeneset. Velo bebet haabel, mippene shez' yeme abelut huqqeshu lez' yeme hechag leinyan issur asiyyat melaka, shenneemar: "vehapakti chaggekem leebel". Vehu haddin li"vehu rachum" sheomeri[yam] beb' veHashem. Veap leachar sheyyatzeu mibbet hechatan vehaabel ubau lebattehem — en tzerikim lomar tachanun, lepi shemmeqomo hu miyyad achar tepillat y"ch, vekevan shennidcha mimmeqom qebiuto — nidcha legamre. Vehu haddin li"vehu rachum" bimdinot ellu shennohagim lomar qodem nepilat appayim bekol hayyamim, ap al pi sheamirato choba kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ql"d (mikkol maqom kevan shechiyyubo eno ella mippene hamminhag veakshav nipteru milleomro bishat chiyyubo, dehaynu bazzeman shennohagim leomro bekol yom shehu miyyad achar tepillat y"ch qodem nepilat appayim — nipteru kol hayyom). Abal berosh chodesh shennohagim sheen omerim hallel bebet haebel (yesh lekol echad lomar hallel achar kak keshebba lebeto, shemmitzvat hallel hi kol hayyom veen meqomo qabua miyyad achar tepillat y"ch, sheapillu qodem hattepilla tzarik liqroto lipamim kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tk"b, veen tzarik lomar achar hattepilla, shezzemannah kol hayyom apillu layyachid berosh chodesh, veen omerim oto miyyad achar tepillat shacharit ella mishshum "zerizin maqdimin lemitzvot". Veod sheeno domeh li"vehu rachum" shehayu peturim milleomro bishat chobato mippene haabelut shel abel shehi lo keyom tob, abal min hallel enam peturim ella shemmippene haabelut shebbabbayit en rotzim lomar sham "lo hammetim yehalelu ya" mippene shennireh keloeg larash, lepikak tzerikim latzet mishsham veliqrot, kemo shehammitpallel keshehu mehallek badderek vehiggia etzel qebarot achar y"ch miyyad, shehu tzarik leharchiq mishsham mishshum "loeg larash" veliqrot hallel). Bammeh debarim amurim? Behallel shel rosh chodesh, shechiyyubo eno ella minhag velo nahagu liqrot bebet haabel, abal bachanukka shehahallel hu choba mittaqqanat chakamim — qorim gam bebet haabel, sheggam haabel chayyab bo. Ella shennohagim shehaabel kol l' veal abiv veal immo kol y"b chodesh — eno ober lipne hatteba beet hahallel, ki haqqahal az besimcha keen shabbatot veyamim tobim:

En monein millippol al penehem beyom hammila ella bebet hakkeneset shehammila bo, abal bebet hakkeneset acher — nopelin. Ubizman haqqor shemmalin hattinoq bebeto — nohagim shello lippol al penehem bebet hakkeneset shebbaal habberit mitpallel sham. Vekol zeh bitpillat shacharit shemmalin az hattinoq, abal bemincha ap al pi shemmitpalelin etzel hattinoq — omerim tachanun. Mah sheen ken bechatan, sheen omerim tachanun kol hayyom keshemmitpalelim etzel hechatan, o im ba lebet hakkeneset, beyom kenisato lachuppa. Veyesh meqomot nohagim sheen hachatanim holekim lebet hakkeneset yom o yomayim qodem hachuppa, kede sheyyukelu haqqahal lomar tachanun. Ak im niknesu lebet hakkeneset omerim tachanun, lebad miyyom hachuppa. Veyesh nohagim shello lomar tachanun kol z' keshehechatan bebet hakkeneset, shekkol z' yeme hammishteh hem lo keregel. Vaapillu beyom ch' lechuppato (beshacharit) en nohagim lippol al penehem, kevan shehayeta hachuppa samuk laereb (velo nishlemu z' yamim ad yom ch' baet hahi). Veyesh meqomot nohagim shello lomar tachanun gam bemincha keshemmitpalelim etzel hattinoq. Abal bebet hakkeneset nopelim ap al pi shebbaal habberit mitpallel sham. Ubeshabbat omerim "tzidqateka tzedeq" apillu en osin hasseuda ella ballayla: hasimanim hachasarim ad siman qn"ch la yadanv mah hih laham ky la hiv badapos maolam vachabal al dabadin chadashim maqarob namatzav bamatachat harab qn"h vqn"v vh' yorinv dat lahair aininv bamaor toratv aman:
